
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Can-daydayup/p/19270856" title="发布于 2025-11-26 08:11">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C# 中 ?、??、??=、?: 、?. 、?[] 各种问号的用法和说明</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在 C# 中，问号（?）远不止是一个简单的标点符号。随着语言版本的迭代更新，C# 围绕问号（?）发展出了一套强大而优雅的空值处理和条件表达机制。熟练掌握这些操作运算符不仅能大幅提升代码的简洁性和可读性，还能有效避免恼人的空引用异常，构建更加健壮的应用程序。</span></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>可空类型修饰符（?）</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在 C# 中，值类型（如int、long、bool、DateTime等）默认不能为null。使用 ? 修饰符，我们可以将值类型转换为可空类型。</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaND0emF7eY3LKEf4rTgFwU17SAM0Qjgdr2GTan7zUaxyUQGobx1ibaAoPEJPunmOOTORKZB33PVmD/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;int<span>&nbsp;notNullableInt;// 非空int类型默认为 0<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;int<span>? nullableInt =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;bool<span>? nullableBool =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;long<span>? nullableLong =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; DateTime? nullableDate =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 检查是否有值<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;(nullableInt.HasValue)<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(<span>$"整数值:&nbsp;<span>{nullableInt.Value}<span>"<span>);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;else<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine("变量没有值（为null）"<span>);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 合并运算符（??）</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 合并运算符（??）如果左边的值不为null，则返回左边的值，否则返回右边的值。</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaND0emF7eY3LKEf4rTgFwU17SAM0Qjgdr2GTan7zUaxyUQGobx1ibaAoPEJPunmOOTORKZB33PVmD/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>static<span>&nbsp;<span>void<span>&nbsp;<span>Main<span>(<span>string<span>[] args<span>)<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>&nbsp;userName1 =&nbsp;"小明"<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>&nbsp;userName2 =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;getUserName = userName1 ?? userName2 ??&nbsp;"默认用户"<span>;<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(getUserName);&nbsp;// 输出: 小明<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>&nbsp;config1 =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>&nbsp;config2 =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>&nbsp;config3 =&nbsp;"DefaultConfig"<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>&nbsp;finalConfig = config1 ?? config2 ?? config3 ??&nbsp;"FallbackConfig"<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(finalConfig);&nbsp;// 输出: DefaultConfig<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 合并赋值运算符（??=）</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>C# 8.0 引入的运算符，仅当左操作数为null时，才将右操作数的值赋给左操作数。这是懒加载模式的理想选择。</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaND0emF7eY3LKEf4rTgFwU17SAM0Qjgdr2GTan7zUaxyUQGobx1ibaAoPEJPunmOOTORKZB33PVmD/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>static<span>&nbsp;<span>void<span>&nbsp;<span>Main<span>(<span>string<span>[] args<span>)<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;string<span>? name =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; name ??=&nbsp;"时光者"<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(name);&nbsp;// 时光者<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; name ??=&nbsp;"大姚"<span>;&nbsp;// 不改变<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(name);&nbsp;// 时光者<br><br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;//惰性初始化<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Dictionary&lt;string<span>,&nbsp;string<span>&gt;? cache =&nbsp;null<span>;<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; cache ??=&nbsp;new<span>&nbsp;Dictionary&lt;string<span>,&nbsp;string<span>&gt;();<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; cache["UserName"<span>] = name;<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(cache["UserName"<span>]);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>三元条件运算符（?:）</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>条件运算符(?:)，又称三元运算符，是一种简洁的条件表达式形式。它对布尔表达式进行求值，并根据结果为true或false，选择性地返回两个表达式中的对应结果，为简单条件判断提供了一种比传统if-else语句更紧凑、表达力更强的语法形式。</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaND0emF7eY3LKEf4rTgFwU17SAM0Qjgdr2GTan7zUaxyUQGobx1ibaAoPEJPunmOOTORKZB33PVmD/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; static void Main(string[] args)<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int score = 80;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; string level = score &gt;= 60 ?&nbsp;"Pass"<span>&nbsp;:&nbsp;"Fail"<span>;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(level);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 条件成员访问运算符 (?.)</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 条件成员访问运算符 (?.) 在访问对象成员（属性、方法、字段等）前先检查对象是否为 null。如果对象为 null，整个表达式返回 null 而不会抛出 NullReferenceException；如果对象不为 null，则正常访问成员。</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaND0emF7eY3LKEf4rTgFwU17SAM0Qjgdr2GTan7zUaxyUQGobx1ibaAoPEJPunmOOTORKZB33PVmD/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; static void Main(string[] args)<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 基本用法<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Person person = null;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; string name = person?.Name; // 不会抛出异常，name 为 null<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(name ??&nbsp;"name is null"<span>); // 输出: name is null<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 条件索引访问运算符 (?[])</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Null 条件索引访问运算符 (?[]) 在使用索引器访问集合元素前先检查集合对象是否为 null。如果集合为 null，整个表达式返回 null 而不会抛出异常；如果集合不为 null，则正常访问索引位置的元素。</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaND0emF7eY3LKEf4rTgFwU17SAM0Qjgdr2GTan7zUaxyUQGobx1ibaAoPEJPunmOOTORKZB33PVmD/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; static void Main(string[] args)<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; List&lt;string&gt; names = null;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; string firstName = names?[0]; // 不会抛出异常，firstName 为 null<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(firstName ??&nbsp;"No names available"<span>); // 输出: No names available<br><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 初始化列表后访问<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; names = new List&lt;string&gt; {&nbsp;"时光者"<span>,&nbsp;"小袁"<span>,&nbsp;"大姚"<span>&nbsp;};<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; string secondName = names?[0]; // 安全访问索引为0的元素<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Console.WriteLine(secondName); // 输出: 时光者<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
